segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: some say it did nothing for spots and made their face look shinier/oilier over the day, while others report a nice glow and no extra breakouts.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including a dry/sensitive cream-formula user in her 40s, report comfortable hydration, a plumping/bouncy feel and brightening with no stinging or heaviness.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (including combination-oily and combo-acne-prone) mostly report no breakouts and some improvement in discoloration, though one found it unremarkable and slightly more oily-feeling.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most divided segment: many describe it as the first vitamin C that doesn't sting, irritate or break them out, but several others report severe breakouts, cysts, red bumps or burning that resolved only after stopping use.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (40s–70s) consistently report visible improvement in fine lines, firmness, texture and brightness within weeks.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for fine lines and wrinkles around the mouth and eyes report visible softening and smoother texture within one to several weeks, with no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe the serum as lightweight yet hydrating, giving a plumped, bouncy, moisturized feel, sometimes credited to added hyaluronic acid.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with possible rosacea-type redness and blotchiness reports no irritation and improved tone; another with reactive skin reports a breakout with red bumps and cysts, so results are inconsistent.
concerns.barrier: A reviewer explicitly citing good skin barrier reports the product layers well and adds glow without compromising it; no barrier-damage complaints appear.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers using it for dark spots and hyperpigmentation report visible fading within days to a few months; one reviewer with melasma reports no noticeable results despite repeated purchases.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report fewer active breakouts and faded acne scars, but a notable minority report the product triggered new breakouts, clogged pores or cystic pimples, sometimes stopping use as a result.
concerns.oiliness: Reports conflict: some oily-skin users say the formula feels oily/sticky and increases shine through the day, while others with oily skin report it absorbs well and adds glow without extra oil.

aspects.libelle: Affordable versus high-end vitamin C serums

extraits.texte: I wanted to like this because I saw nothing but good reviews and I have used it before but stopped because of other skin issues. I have very reactive and sensitive skin so this vitamin c broke me out including cysts and red bumps all over my cheeks. I am still recovering from this breakout after discontinuing this product 2 weeks ago. I think I need something less aggressive and more for sensitivity/acne prone skin.

I'm currently on my second bottle and I only use it in the morning. I have oily skin that can sometimes be dry and acne-prone, but unfortunately I didn't notice any difference in my skin. It didn't help with my darker spots, and the formula is quite oily. I also use the Byoma sunscreen, which I find oily as well, so after some time following my morning skincare routine, my face already looks very oily and shiny.

I've been using Vitamin C serum for years to help even out and brighten my skin tone. I used to use a serum by La Roche Posay but it was too expensive and I wanted a cheaper option. I also didn't notice any of my desired effects from La Roche Posay so I decided to try the Naturium Vitamin C serum. I've bought this product twice because it's more affordable but I'm still not noticing any different with my dull, uneven tone. I have Melasma so I know there's a limit to what over the counter products can do, but I was hoping for ANY results. I'll probably keep using this product because I'm holding out hope to notice a difference but this isn't remarkable. I gave it 3 stars because of the price and it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin.

Glad the smaller size is an option. I have combination oily skin. After using this consistently, overall I feel this is unnecessary/unremarkable for my skin. I haven't really noticed any benefits or changes. My skin does feel oilier than usual when I use this, even when combined with a niacinamide serum. It has a nice consistency and the packaging is cute and functional. It's worth a try if you're looking for something like this, I won't repurchase though.

extraits.titre: It does work well for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I saw an ad for this saying it works well with sensitive skin. I decided to give it a try since I could get a travel/trial size and get at my local Ulta. I haven't used a vitamin C in years because in my mid 40's/perimenopause era my skin has gotten so difficult. It gets red, blotchy and bumps very easily. I might have slight rosace? But I can say, this does not irritate my skin at all! I've been using it about a month now. I think it's clearing and improving my skin tone. Great price too.

Skin Type: Dry, Sensitive Age: 40s I've been using this vitamin C cream from Naturium consistently, and it's become an easy staple in my routine. What stood out to me right away was how comfortable it feels on my skin—no stinging, no irritation, and no heaviness, which can be hard to find with vitamin C products when you have dry, sensitive skin. I like that this is a cream formula rather than a watery serum. It hydrates while still giving my skin a brighter, more even look over time, and it layers well under moisturizer and sunscreen. I also appreciate that it fits into a simple routine without feeling overcomplicated or aggressive. This isn't a product that promises overnight results, but with consistent use my skin looks healthier and more balanced. If you're looking for a vitamin C that supports skin health long‑term and plays well with sensitive skin, this is worth trying.

I have tried many different vitamin c serums throughout the years. I have very sensitive, acne prone skin. Many serums have irritated my skin. This is the best I have ever tried. It is extremely gentle, and actually helped with controlling acne. My dark spots have completely vanished, my skin tone is even, pores appear smaller, my skin looks firmer, and it gives me a beautiful glow. I have had multiple people comment on how beautiful my skin is after I started using this product. I will never be without it!
